tips.name: The Accountability Text
tips.action: Text one friend the habit you are starting this week
tips.reason: Telling someone who will ask about it makes a new habit easier to keep going.
tips.note: takes real effort; a weekly practice

tips.name: Your Alarm Is Lying To You
tips.action: Keep one fixed wake-up time, even at weekends
tips.reason: A steady wake-up time is a reasonable habit, but it is a setup, not a daily step.
tips.note: general principle without one daily action

tips.name: Make Laziness Your Superpower
tips.action: Make the good choice the easiest one to reach
tips.reason: Sound in spirit, but too general to tick off on a printed list.
tips.note: left out: no single action to take

tips.name: Step Into Morning Daylight
tips.action: Get a few minutes of daylight on the way out
tips.reason: Daylight early in the day helps set the body clock; never look straight at the sun.
tips.note: renamed: the title reads as an instruction to stare at the sun

tips.name: Sit Up Straight, You're Not Dead Yet
tips.action: Roll your shoulders back and sit tall
tips.reason: A quick posture reset eases the neck and back during long sitting.
tips.note: daily, a few seconds, due at the desk

tips.name: The Golden Rule of Habit-Building
tips.action: Start new habits small enough to never skip
tips.reason: Tiny starts are easier to repeat; it is a principle rather than one daily action.

tips.name: Fire Your Morning Brain
tips.action: Splash cold water on your face after brushing
tips.reason: A short cold splash is an easy wake-up cue tied to a routine you already have.
tips.note: daily, under a minute, due in the bathroom

tips.name: The Two-Minute Brain Trick
tips.action: Do the first two minutes of a task you are avoiding
tips.reason: Starting is the hardest part, and two minutes is small enough to begin.
tips.note: daily, but tied to no single place

tips.name: Unfollow Your Ghosts
tips.action: Unfollow accounts that leave you feeling worse
tips.reason: A periodic tidy of your feeds removes things that drag your mood down.
tips.note: a monthly review that takes some time

tips.name: Your Brain Is A Raisin
tips.action: Drink a glass of water before anything else
tips.reason: Starting the day with water is a two-second habit that is easy to attach to a cue.
tips.note: daily, due at the first drink of the day
